## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2022-08-24: SPAC Transaction Agreement executed between GSR II Meteora Acquisition Corp., BT Assets, Inc., and Lux Vending, LLC; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit 10.3.
- 2023-06-13: 8-K announcing the Fourth Amendment to the Transaction Agreement attaches a final-form TRA referencing the new BT HoldCo LLC entity structure.
- 2023-06-30: Up-C Closing; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated June 30, 2023 between Bitcoin Depot Inc., BT HoldCo LLC, and BT Assets, Inc.
- 2023-07-07: 8-K reporting Closing files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

#### Up-C Collapse termination

- 2025-05-30: Agreement and Plan of Merger executed and consummated; Section 1.1(r) terminates the TRA effective immediately following the Contribution. 8-K Item 1.02 reports the termination. $8.4M cash paid to former BT Assets stockholders as negotiated consideration.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Bitcoin Depot's June 30, 2023 SPAC business combination (GSR II Meteora Acquisition Corp. combined with the BT Assets / Lux Vending operating structure), with BT Assets, Inc. (a Brandon Mintz-controlled vehicle) as the sole TRA Holder. Bitcoin Depot paid 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups from exchanges of BT HoldCo Common Units, disproportionate Section 704(c) allocations, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The May 30, 2025 Up-C Collapse merger terminated the TRA by force of a provision in the Agreement and Plan of Merger (Section 1.1(r)), with an $8.4M cash payment to BT Assets stockholders as negotiated consideration; the TRA's carrying value was derecognized to additional paid-in capital under common-control accounting. See `contract_log.md` for the same-contract reasoning across the form-of and executed versions, and for the termination instrument analysis.
